name: dnostracker
description: Hourly habit tracker for health, work, prep, workout, social, stress, and study — with a flexible sleep window.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --omit=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --omit=dev --prefix server
